name: winner-poker-app
description: Winner winner chicken dinner — native app (iOS/Android) built from the website code, same Supabase backend.

scripts.android: npm run build && (test -d android || npx cap add android) && node scripts/patch-native.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios: npm run build && (test -d ios || npx cap add ios) && node scripts/patch-native.mjs && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
